parts.question: What is the current renal starting dose of AX-17?

result.answer: The current renal starting doses of AX-17 in Germany are as follows: for Normal renal function (eGFR >=90), the starting dose is 50 mg OD; for Mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89), the starting dose is 50 mg OD; for Moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg OD; and for Severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29), specialist review is required for the starting dose [E2]. Specifically, the approved German renal starting dose for moderate renal impairment is 25 mg once daily [E1, E3].
